directionSemantics.IN: Tesla OEM speaker-level source -> HELIX V TWELVE DSP MK2 HIGHLEVEL INPUT

labelingRule.summary: Use the newly photographed Bünde Highland lead sleeves, not the old Ryzen 1.7B repin workflow. Physical cavity placement on the replacement plugs is NOT verified by the photos.
labelingRule.inputPolarity: On the V TWELVE HIGHLEVEL INPUT connector, each channel is printed -X +X. Connect sleeve IN - to -X and sleeve IN + to +X.
labelingRule.outputPolarity: On the V TWELVE OUTPUT CHANNELS connector, each channel is printed +X -X. Connect sleeve OUT + to +X and sleeve OUT - to -X.
labelingRule.critical: Power off; verify actual new harness plug pin continuity and IN/OUT isolation before energizing. NO direct amplifier-to-amplifier or output-to-OEM-source connection.
